（批：张西萍）
Translation the attached Chinese letter addressed to Con. No. 1856.
Tsang Hai Ping, aged 22, native of Szechuen, B'well Station No. A. 7641,
sentenced to 2 years and 6 months Impr. for "Being concerned in
forming a party to injure the Chinese Republic" from Cousin Woo Chin
situated at The Y.M.C.A., Tientsin. 天津基督教青年会 吴琴
（批：海萍）
Brother Hai Ping,
Are you well? Recently I came to Shanghai for some
affairs and was anxious to to see you if possible, but I was told
by the Gaol authority that you was not entitled to be visited at that
time. Anyhow, I hope will look after your own health and do not
worry anything else. I am quite well here. I lived two weeks in
Shanghai last time for I was very busy here. （批：杨布）Yang Bu is studying
in the "（批：霍山）Lou-gang" Military Training School and （批：秋风）Chu Fong is training
in Si-an. Please mail me some words through Brother Ziang, for
I sall be transferred to Shanghai shortly.
（批：琴）
From Chin.
Dated 20/8/36.
page_data.zh:
（批：张西萍）
翻译附上的写给第 1856 号囚犯的中文信件。
Tsang Hai Ping，22 岁，四川人，静安寺警局编号 A. 7641，
因“参与组建损害中华民国之团体”被判处
2 年 6 个月监禁，来信者为表亲 Woo Chin
地址为天津基督教青年会。 天津基督教青年会 吴琴
（批：海萍）
海萍兄：
你好吗？最近我因事来沪，本想尽可能见你一面，但据
监狱当局告知，当时你不准探视。无论如何，希望你保重身体，不要
为其他事情担忧。我在这里一切安好。上次我在
上海住了两周，因为我在这里非常忙碌。（批：杨布）杨布正在
“（批：霍山）Lou-gang”军事训练学校学习，而（批：秋风）Chu Fong 正在西安受训。请通过 Ziang 兄给我寄些消息，因为
我很快就要调往上海。
（批：琴）
来自 Chin。
日期 1936年8月20日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Date

February 1 36.

Dear Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information
tabulated statements of three communists arrested
by the Municipal Police on December 10, 1935.
Lists of Communist literature seized and photographs
of the accused are also attached.

The three accused were on December 24, 1935,
sentenced to 2½ years' imprisonment each by the
Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court.

Yours sincerely,

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Chief of the Political Section,
French Municipal Police.

（批：* All enclosed.
-abb 2/2）

Subject Resume of Case against members of Chinese Communist Youth League -
[涂改痕迹]
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by O.B. Rae O.C.

The Chinese Communist Youth League, an important branch of
the Communist Party wherein budding communists are taught the
fundamentals of communism before becoming eligible for membership
in the Party itself, has not escaped the repressive measures
put into force by the Police of the three Municipalities in an
effort to stamp out the communist menace in this city. The
Municipal Police have done much to prevent communism from
assuming dangerous proportions in the International Settlement.
Between September 16 and 17, 1935 some eight communist suspects,
the majority of whom were found to be connected in some capacity
or another with the Chinese Communist Youth League, were arrested
in the Settlement and subsequently extradited to the Chinese
authorities. Since this series of arrests were made the efforts
of the staff of this Section to checkmate the activities of
subversive elements in our midst have continued unabated and are
still producing good results.

After a great deal of preliminary investigation work
information was obtained on November 27, 1935 by C.D.S. 155,
attached to this Section, that agents of the Chinese Communist
[涂改痕迹] League were carrying out subversive propaganda work in the
North Szechuen Road area of the International Settlement. Such
facts as were known to him he reported to his superior, D.I. Kuh
Pao Hwa, who throughout the case advised as to the best means of
continuing enquiries and materially assisted in bringing the case

success was met with when C.D.S. 155 tracked to his lair at

PROCEEDINGS. Mr Kum appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Mr Kum:- ( Case reoutlined for Judge Zau)
During the period of remand the 3rd accused was taken to the
house on Avenue Road and the Chief Tenant there stated that he had
seen the 3rd accused there on two occasions. All the papers seized
at the house and on the accused are of a Communistic nature.
1st Accused:- I know nothing about these papers.
They were given to me by a man named Wong. I was carrying a parcel
when I was arrested. I was told to take it to the Corner of Hart
and Ave Foch where I was to give it to a man who would be there
with a book in his hand. The papers in this parcel were not to be
distributed. I live with the 2nd accused. He did not give me the
parcel. I moved to hos home on the 7/12/35. I took this
small box into the house. The large box is also mine, but when
I took it to the house it was full of clothes. I do not know
anything about Communists. In August I came to Shanghai from
Nanking and met a man named Tsung who took me to a house in
Taku Road. It was there he introduced me to a man named Wong.
Later I moved to a house on Wuting Road. Wong asked me to join
the Anti-Japanese Society. He never mentioned Communism to me. I
never actually joined the society. I have carried papers for Wong
on about six occasions. When Wong had no money with which to pay
rent he introduced me to a house on North Szechuen Road and then
on the 7/12/35 he took me to the Home of the 2nd accused on
Avenue Road. I admit that I signed this statement produced in
Court. I do not know what office the 2nd accused holds in the
Communist party.

Acting on information to the effect that persons in possession of communistic literature were residing at House 22, Lane 1177 Avenue Road, C.D.S.155 attached to Special Branch (Sgt.) waited outside that address on the early morning of 1st. 10/12/35 and at about 7-35am. observed the/accused leaving and in possession of a paper parcel.

He followed this accused West on Avenue Road with the intention of discovering his destination, but on reaching Avenue and Hart Roads the 1st. accused realised that he was being followed and started to run. He was pursued and arrested, then brought to this station, where the parcel was found to contain the following:

215 copies of "Truth of youth newspaper"
110 copies of "Truth of youth booklets."

1. 《青年真理报》第108期（1935年12月5日出版）的第1和第2页，包含以下标题：-
A) 日本派遣陆海空军部队前往华北；将以武力实施华北自治。
B) 日军占领丰台和北平火车站。
C) 日本帝国主义者宣布，其军队进入华北已获蒋介石将军批准。
D) 殖民地民族解放斗争；埃及民众举行武装示威。
E) 东非的意大利工人反对意大利入侵阿比西尼亚。
F) 红军向湖南进军。
G) 一幅漫画，描绘一名日本人手持中国地图，并写有“日本帝国主义者吞并中国”字样。
105份

2. 《青年真理报》第108期（1935年12月5日出版）的第3和第4页，包含以下标题：-
A) 闸北黄记人力车公司人力车夫罢工成功。
B) 南市人力车夫罢工成功。
C) 美亚六厂工人举行罢工，反对降低工资15%。
D) 坤中棉纺厂女工举行“太公”罢工，要求增加工资。
E) 闸北粪夫罢工。
110份

3. 《青年真理小册子》，内含一首纪念广州起义的歌曲及以下漫画：
A) 描绘1927年4月12日蒋介石屠杀劳工的情景，
B) 描绘南昌暴动期间朱培德将军被共产党人赶出南昌的情景。
C) 描绘广州起义的情景。
D) 描绘汪精卫屠杀人民的情景。
E) 描绘人们举行集会纪念广州起义的情景。
F) 描绘工人离开工厂，士兵举起武器（这幅漫画旁边题有“停工、停训、停课、抗日”字样）。
每本小册子末尾均附有一张展示红军在中国各地分布情况的地图。
110份

在曾海平（第三被告）身上搜获的共产主义文件清单。曾于1935年12月10日进入爱文义路1177弄22号的共产主义据点时被捕，该据点于当日早些时候遭到突袭，导致大量共产主义宣传册被查获。

1. 一张便条，致“郭通”（“油印股”的化名），指示印刷一份“中央”的宣言和一份关于“浩尊”（“省委”的化名）决议的公告，并就与“出版股”（“正总”的化名）会面事宜的方法咨询发件人“洪道”（某共产主义机关的化名）。

2. 一张便条，由“昆仲”（“中央”的化名）致“浩尊”和“钱雄”（分别为“省委”和“省委宣传部”的化名），日期为12月12日，讨论一篇涉及华北局势的共产主义文章的字句。

3. 一小片纸，上面有一张致“曹华”（某机关的化名）的便条，索要钱财，并询问收信人是否解决了与其工作和居住地有关的问题。无签名。背面写有“山东”。

4. 一份关于九一八周年纪念期间行动的通知草稿。

5. 一张便条，指示出版股提交一份关于出版工作的报告，并附有一些关于出版问题的疑问。

上述证物装在一个信封内，信封抬头为“中国上海圣约翰大学”，收件人为：-
俞玉權先生，江湾复旦大学。

6. 一份油印期刊，题为《火炬月刊》第5期，内含一篇文章，赞扬十月革命，并指责中国“重要人物”追求私利，不顾人民福祉。

7) 一封致梁考松的信，由俊（音译）发出，转交林慧仙小姐，日期为12月6日，介绍持信人（？林小姐）加入“火炬月刊社”，称该社“因缺乏得力人员，尚不完善”。

page_data.en:
Wong Tuh Yuin( 王德閏 ) 1st. accused.
Honan.                                      D.S. Jones.
B'Well Stn.           10/12/35.             D.S.I.Shih Sz Chen.

I am 24 years of age and was born in Kaifeng and began
my education at the age of 9 years, studying under a private
tutor at home for four years. I then began to attend the
4th. Provincial Middle School at Hsuchang, remaining there
for three years, when I returned to Kaifeng to enrol as a
student at the Kaifeng High Middle School. Altogether I studied
for three years at this school, but during this period I went
home for one year because of domestic matters. I finally left
school at the age of 20 years and for nearly two years I was
employed in the capacity of clerk to a lawyer at Kaifeng. This
lawyer was a relation; he gave me my board and keep but no
salary. In August 1933 I left him and came to Shanghai for the
purpose of resuming my studies. For about a fortnight after
my arrival here I stayed with my friend at the Chenju University
At the end of this period I joined the Shanghai Art College
in Rue de Marche, living in. There I took a course of painting
and piano lessons. I left this college in July this year
because my father, a farmer in Kaifeng suffered from the result
of an inundation and could no longer afford to send me
remittances. On leaving the Shanghai Art College I went to
Nanking in search of a job. I did not find work and on or about
August 10th. I returned to Shanghai. After my return I put up
in a lodging house in Chakiang Road and then went to a house
at Taku Road. I was there one month and then removed to North
Szechwan Road near Haining Road. Since December 7th. 1933 I
have occupied a room at No.22, Lane 1177 Avenue Road.
page_data.zh:
王德閏（第一被告）。
河南。                                      D.S. Jones.
百老汇路捕房           1935年12月10日。             D.S.I.施世珍。

我今年24岁，出生于开封，9岁开始受教育，在家跟随私塾老师学习了四年。随后我开始就读于许昌的省立第四中学，在那里读了三年，之后回到开封，考入开封高中。我在这所学校总共学习了三年，但在此期间，因家事回家一年。我最终在20岁时离校，此后近两年在开封一名律师处担任书记员。这名律师是我的亲戚；他提供我的食宿，但不支付薪水。1933年8月，我离开他来到上海，目的是继续求学。抵达上海后的约两周内，我借住在震旦大学的一位朋友处。期满后，我加入了位于马浪路（Rue de Marche）的上海艺术专科学校，并住在校内。我在那里修习绘画和钢琴课程。今年七月我离开了这所学校，因为我在开封务农的父亲遭受水灾影响，无力再给我汇款。离开上海艺术专科学校后，我去南京找工作。我没找到工作，大约在8月10日返回上海。回来后，我先住在乍浦路的一家旅馆，然后搬到大沽路的一处住所。我在那里住了一一个月，随后搬到海宁路附近的北四川路。自1933年12月7日起，我一直居住在爱文义路1177弄22号的一个房间内。

page_data.en:
(Sheet 2)
Wong Tuh Yuin (          ) 1st. accused.

I have been working for the Communist Party since
September 18th. A former schoolmate of mine from the
Shanghai Art College first interested me in communism.
He was known to me as Zung ( 张 ); I do not know his
full name. When I returned from Nanking I met him in the
street and it was he who induced me to live at Taku Road.
The first time he took me to Taku Road, he introduced me to
a man named Wong ( 王 ). I lived with Wong at Taku Road
for one month, sharing with him the room over the kitchen.
In return for the board and lodging I used to carry communist
literature from the house to people who would meet me on the
street at places previously agreed upon. It was on Wong's
instructions that I removed to my present address in Avenue
Road.
On Dec. 7, in the evening Wong took me to a point near the
Kwang Hwa Theatre, Av. Edward VII, where we met a person named
Tseng Ming Hyoeng ( 曾明堃 ). After the introduction I was
told that I had to live with Tseng and so I removed to the
room occupied by Tseng at House 22, Lane 1177 Avenue Road.
Tseng did not discuss communism with me. At 7.30a.m.
to-day (10/12/35) he gave me a package of communist literature
and instructed me to take it to the corner of Hart Road and
Avenue Foch. I was to wait on the corner and hand it to a
man who would approach me and say "Give me something". I do
not know who this man could be. When I had reached Avenue
Road near Hart Road I was arrested. This was the first time
I had done anything for Tseng. I do not know what position
page_data.zh:
（第2页）
王德閏（          ）第一被告。

我自9月18日起一直为共产党工作。我在上海艺术专科学校的一位前同学首先引起了我对共产主义的兴趣。我知道他叫张（音译）；我不知道他的全名。我从南京回来后，在街上遇见了他，是他劝我住到大沽路。他第一次带我去大沽路时，把我介绍给一个叫王（音译）的人。我和王在大沽路同住一个月，合住厨房楼上的一间房。作为食宿的回报，我会将共产主义文献从住处带到街上预先约定的地点，交给与我接头的人。我是按照王的指示搬到现在爱文义路的住址的。
12月7日晚上，王带我到爱德华七世路（Av. Edward VII）光华大戏院附近的一个地方，我们在那里遇见了一个叫曾明堃的人。经介绍后，我被告知必须与曾同住，于是我搬到了曾居住在的爱文义路1177弄22号的房间。曾没有和我讨论共产主义。今天早上（1935年12月10日）7点30分，他给了我一包共产主义文献，指示我把它带到哈同路（Hart Road）和福煦路（Avenue Foch）的拐角处。我要在拐角处等待，把它交给一个走近我说“给我点东西”的人。我不知道这个人会是谁。当我走到哈同路附近的爱文义路时，我被捕了。这是我第一次为曾做事。我不知道曾

page_data.en:
(Sheet 3)
Wong Tub Yuin (          ) 1st. accused.

Tseng held in the Communist Party. Tseng did not promise
me any wages for doing this work. He gave me free board and
lodging.
    I had no hand in writing the communist pamphlets or
making the drawings found on me at the time of my arrest.
    During the three days I have resided in Avenue Road no
visitors have called upon Tseng Ming Hyoong or myself.
page_data.zh:
（第3页）
王德閏（          ）第一被告。

在共产党内担任什么职务。曾没有承诺给我任何工资来做这项工作。他免费提供我食宿。
    我没有参与撰写在我被捕时从我身上搜出的共产主义小册子或绘制其中的插图。
    在我居住于爱文义路的三天期间，没有访客来找过曾明堃或我。

page_data.en:
張 明 熹
Tsang Ming Hyoong. (2nd. accused.)

Anhwei.                                      D.S. Watson.
B'Well Station.        10/12/35.             Y.B.Peu.

                                          鳳 陽
    I am aged 21 and was born in Fung Yang, Anhwei. I was a
student at the Anhwei Middle School, Peiping and I left this
school about one year ago and obtained employment as a writer
of articles for various newspapers in Peiping.
    The 1st. accused named Wong Tuh Yuin ( 王 道 遠 ) was a
student at the same school and that is why I know him.
    In the summer of this year I came to Shanghai to obtain
employment as a writer of articles and resided above a coal
shop named the Tien Zung ( 天 中 ) on Park Road. After staying
in Shanghai for about one month I could not find employment and
returned to Peiping.
    I again came to Shanghai about two months ago and lived
in the Huh Tah Fong, off Hart Road, and obtained employment
as a writer of articles to various newsagents under fictitious
names.
    About three weeks ago I went to live at House 22, Lane 1177
Avenue Road and when visiting the Kwun Hwa Cinema on Avenue
Edward VII about one week ago I met the 1st. accused. He told
me that he had just returned from Honan and I gave him my
address. He told me that he had no employment.
    Three days ago he came to live with me and brought with
him several boxes, bookshelves, pictures and a bed. I do not
know what the boxes contained and none of them were mine.
    I am not a communist and know nothing about the communist
party.

                                Signed. Tsang Ming Hyoong.
page_data.zh:
張 明 熹
曾明堃。（第二被告。）

安徽。                                      D.S. Watson.
百老汇路捕房。        1935年12月10日。             Y.B.Peu.

                                          鳳 陽
    我今年21岁，出生于安徽凤阳。我曾就读于北平的安徽中学，大约一年前离开该校，并在北平受雇为多家报纸撰写文章。
    第一被告王道远（音译）是同一所学校的学生，这就是我认识他的原因。
    今年夏天，我来上海谋求撰稿人的职位，住在派克路（Park Road）一家名为“天中”的煤店楼上。在上海住了大约一个月后，我找不到工作，便回到了北平。
    大约两个月前，我再次来到上海，住在哈同路附近的胡达坊（音译），并以假名受雇为多家新闻代理商撰写文章。
    大约三周前，我搬入爱文义路1177弄22号居住，大约一周前在爱德华七世路的光华电影院看电影时，我遇见了第一被告。他告诉我他刚从河南回来，我便把我的地址给了他。他告诉我他没有工作。

Tang Hai ling (湯海萍) 3rd accused)
Kfeng Yuen, Szechuen
B'well Station    20-2-35    L.S.I. Shih Ssu Chien

I began my education at the age of 6 or 7 years
when I studied in a private school in Kwang Yuen, Szechuen,
my native place. At the age of 10 years I entered a primary
school in the same city, remaining there 5 years. After this
I enrolled as a student at the Kwang Yuen District Middle
School and graduated at the age of 16 years. I then finished
my studies on account of ill health and stayed at home unemplo;
ed for about 2 years. From Sept. 1934 to June 1935 I was
employed as a teacher at the San Sing (三民) Primary School
in Kwang Yuen. From July to November last I was in Nanking.
Unable to find work in Nanking I came to Shanghai, on or about
November 2, 1935. I stayed at No. 243 Tsapoo Road with Ting
Ling Sung (丁林生) from the day of my arrival until December
2. I went to this place on the advice of a friend in Nanking
named Li Sung Ju (李松如), who was acquainted with Ting
Ling Sung. We both left this place on December 2, when Ting
removed to an address unknown to me. Since this date I have had
no fixed abode. Last night I slept in a straw hut in Jessfield
Village.

I did not knock at the window of house No.22, Lane
1177, Avenue Foch. I was simply looking for a room to let
when I was arrested.

The communist literature found on my person was given
to me several days ago by Ting Ling Sung, who instructed
me to leave it at Fudan University, Kiangwan. I did not know
that this literature was communistic. I am not a communist
and do not belong to any political party.

唐海萍（第三名被告）
四川广元
北威尔斯路站    1935年2月20日    律师：施士箴

我六七岁时开始接受教育，在家乡四川广元的一所私塾读书。十岁时，我进入该市的一所小学，在那里读了五年。此后，我考入广元县立中学，并于十六岁毕业。后来因健康原因中止学业，在家待业约两年。从1934年9月至1935年6月，我在广元的三民小学担任教员。去年七月至十一月，我在南京。由于在南京找不到工作，我于1935年11月2日左右来到上海。从抵达之日起至12月2日，我一直与丁林生同住于乍浦路243号。我是经南京一位名叫李松如的朋友介绍去那里的，他认识丁林生。12月2日，我们两人离开了该处，丁林生搬往一个我不知道的地址。自该日起，我便没有固定住所。昨晚，我睡在极司菲尔路村的一间草棚里。

我没有敲霞飞路1177弄22号房屋的窗户。我被捕时只是在寻找出租的房间。

在我身上发现的共产主义文献是几天前由丁林生交给我的，他指示我将这些文献留在江湾的复旦大学。我当时并不知道这些文献是共产主义性质的。我不是共产党员，也不属于任何政党。
